description: Selects enterprise application patterns and transaction boundaries without taking DDD, database, performance, or authorization ownership. Project-agnostic; host-specific governance is optional.
user_intent_examples: Choose the smallest persistence and transaction pattern for this use case.
when_to_load: When enterprise persistence patterns, application services, transactions, object identity, or concurrency-control patterns are the central concern.
when_not_to_load: Do not load for small scripts, simple CRUD, generic dependency architecture, DDD modeling, database tuning, or unmeasured performance work.
do_not_regress: Do not restore JWT, lru_cache, or contextvars as generic session-state substitutes.
Do not default Identity Map to weak references.
Do not present enterprise patterns as a linear maturity ladder.
Do not force companion prompts or startup loading.
